scope: Pilot roots are public discovery tasks. Fixture families provide bounded checks, not answers to open research questions.

roots.title: Adaptive interval queries under asymmetric costs
roots.question: Generalize the exact finite adaptive interval-query setting to nonuniform priors and unequal query costs. Derive a Bellman recursion, identify a nontrivial structural simplification or a counterexample, and compare greedy information gain with exact risk minimization.

roots.title: Research-state quotients under revocation
roots.question: Derive a continuation-equivalence condition that preserves authorization risk and revocation chronology. Construct the smallest separating example for posterior-only compression. State the future event contract explicitly.

roots.title: Stopping under hidden pre-peeks
roots.question: Develop a validity audit for sequential researcher decisions under acquisition-order uncertainty. Give a finite sharp witness and a policy that reduces risk without forbidding informative public queries.

roots.title: Correlated semantic errors across three proof pipelines
roots.question: Generalize the conditional false-authorization polytope to three verification pipelines with marginal and pairwise constraints. Characterize sharp triple intersections and propose a Lean-compatible finite certificate.

roots.title: Routing-aware interventional separation
roots.question: Generalize finite mechanism separation to stochastic routing and noisy readouts. Compare missingness with negative evidence. Derive a cost-aware probe policy and propose matched-sham controls for a looped transformer.

roots.title: Latent loop depth and causal identifiability
roots.question: Design a recurrent research policy that selects intervention layer, expert, visit and readout under a cost budget. Derive a deterministic finite baseline and specify an empirical test distinguishing clock-based routing from state-dependent routing.

roots.title: Self-designed evaluation under a finite attacker class
roots.question: Construct a finite resource-bounded self-evaluation game. Analyze whether a clever adaptive audit avoids a conjectured exponential floor. Distinguish asymptotic claims from finite witnesses.

roots.title: Compressed critique as an information channel
roots.question: Treat a critic's hidden hints as bounded messages. Derive a sharp conditional false-authorization bound with heterogeneous per-transcript message alphabets and develop a critique firewall.

roots.title: Planning under nested public and private observations
roots.question: Develop a finite belief-state planning model with acquisition-order restrictions. Determine when a policy can collapse two histories without changing the downstream value or invalidating evaluation.

roots.title: Semantic mutation with correlated verification failures
roots.question: Design a family-disjoint challenge for quantifier order and proof scope. Analyze what a joint proof-fidelity score can certify under correlated errors, and formulate a fresh confirmatory protocol.

roots.title: Lossy quotient of a research transcript
roots.question: Derive sufficient-state conditions for budgeted adaptive query policies; compare exact partition refinement and value-aware approximations. Construct a witness where small predictive error still causes a poor downstream decision.

roots.title: Mechanism equivalence under finite probe budgets
roots.question: Study policy-relative equivalence among mechanisms when some interventions are unreachable. Derive an exact finite cover or impossibility certificate and propose a prospective neural evaluation with independent-world power analysis.
